mods.name: PlayerSwap
mods.description: Minecraft, but the players rotate every minute.

releases.notes:
In single player, this is just a timer.

Use "/playerswap add \<time>" to modify the timer at any time. (\<time> needs to be provided as defined below)
Writing duplicates like "1d 1d -5m 3m" (1d 23h 58m) will work too, if needed.

Use "/playerswap start [time]" to start the timer. (optionally at a given time)
Any given time unit will be the last one provided in case of duplicates ("1d 1d 5m -3m" will result in "1d -3m"/"23h 57m")

\<time> values may be negative or positive while written like "1d -5s" (will display as "23h 59m 55s"), using a number (no length limit) directly followed by either s, m, h, d, w or y.

In multiplayer, every minute all players will swap places and inventories in alphabetical order.
The cooldown can be changed using "/playerswap swap \<time>" using the same time format as above (additive). If the resulting total seconds are negative, Java treats it like they're positive when applying the modulus check for swapping, so it makes no difference.
